gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all notification schemes available in the Jira Cloud platform so that I can understand the current configurations and make necessary adjustments.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all notification schemes with their respective IDs, names, and descriptions.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new notification scheme to ensure that team members receive alerts for specific events in our projects.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the scheme details and return the newly created notification scheme's ID and status.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to see which notification schemes are mapped to my projects so that I can verify that the correct notifications are being sent.
gold.ideal: The API should return a mapping of project IDs to their respective notification scheme IDs.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to retrieve the details of a specific notification scheme to understand its configuration and how it affects my project.
gold.ideal: The API should return the notification scheme's details, including its ID, name, and the list of notifications configured.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to update an existing notification scheme to modify the recipients of certain notifications based on team changes.
gold.ideal: The API should accept updated details for the notification scheme and return the updated scheme's ID and status.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to add new notifications to an existing notification scheme to ensure that all relevant team members are informed of critical updates.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a list of notifications to be added and return the updated notification scheme details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to delete an obsolete notification scheme to clean up our configurations and avoid confusion.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the notification scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to remove a specific notification from a notification scheme to prevent unnecessary alerts from being sent to team members.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the removal of the notification and return the updated notification scheme details.
